Alani Kelso

A Division Agent who appears in Broken Dawn's Washington sequence as the recipient of April Kelleher's source-specific antiviral intelligence.

Connectionnot applicable Continuitydivision transmedia Canon scopeofficial transmedia Verificationsource reviewed Reviewed2026-07-28

Washington connection

Kelso's Broken Dawn appearance creates a source-specific bridge from April's civilian research trail to an SHD contact in Washington. The archive labels that bridge official transmedia rather than retroactively treating it as a game mission. [1]

Claim ledger

Every factual statement below must retain at least one traceable source.

  1. confirmed

    Broken Dawn depicts Alani Kelso as a Division Agent operating in Washington during the novel's final intelligence handoff. [1]

  2. confirmed

    April Kelleher gives Kelso the novel's resulting research intelligence, including the lead's security risk and Ike Ronson's involvement. [1]
